if: the document is a tax invoice required by section 31 and issued under rule 46 of the CGST Rules, 2017
no provision of rule 54 (tax invoice in special cases) displaces the particular
then: the tax invoice MUST state whether the tax is payable on a reverse charge basis
note: One mandatory particular of rule 46(p), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.
